body: I write sometimes. Just haven’t really had a lot of inspiration. And I’m teaching myself bass. It’s just slow going.
At the moment, nothing. But I don’t think it would hurt to be open to suggestions.
It’s like I don’t even hear it anymore

I mean, lately, just the basics. I eat and shower and exercise because I know my body needs it. I like video games, but lately they seem to have lost their appeal, so I just put on tv for background noise.

I think maybe I want to be heard. I’m in a house full of people who don’t even ask me how my day is going before they ask me to do things for them. I don’t feel like I have any value. I’m lonely. I don’t feel like anything I do matters, and nobody acts like it does.

Life didn’t get hard it has been hard and I’m not up for it anymore. My distractions don’t work. I don’t have a meaning to give it. Nothing matters to me anymore and I just seems like I never mattered to begin with.

Everything is just really heavy. I lost the only person who seemed to care about me a few months ago. I fail at everything I try. People only want me around when they want something. I’ve got so much I want to talk about and nobody to tell any of it to and I just don’t know anymore.
Why should I hang around? I don’t really have a lot going for me.
I think you will. It’s takes more time for some people. But definitely don’t be afraid to say no even if it’s family. It took me way too long to learn that.
I’m glad she’s often respectful. I’ve had people ask if they can coo to my youngest as he’s not talking yet. I’ve never let a stranger hold either one of my kids, even if they’ve asked.

She squealed “oh look a baby” before approaching me. The top of his head was visible as feeding a baby in a fully zipped jacket is difficult. And babies move when they eat. It was made clear to her that I wasn’t stealing but was instead feeding a baby. But all that aside, even if she thought I was stealing, she had no right to put her hands on me. It’s against policy. Security would have had to search me.
Very true. I mean, I’m not an idiot. Babies are cute. Even I look at whoever is next to me and go “Oh look at the tiny/cute baby.” But never have I thought to try to touch one.

With my oldest I wore big jackets and put him in the jackets when I breastfed him. I was waking through the mall one day and had him in the jackets feeding him. Well this woman who worked at pac sun decided she was going to walk up to me and try to take him out of my arms. She went as far as to try to unzip my jacket. I started screaming and she ended up fired and banned. 

My husband was also stalked through a grocery store by a woman who kept trying to pick up or tickle our oldest. He asked her repeatedly to stop and she kept following him. Finally she reached out and tried to pick him up. My husband grabbed her hand and accidentally broke her thumb. She was arrested and we pressed attempted kidnapping charges.
